name: Retro Eras
description: Visit dimensions that recreate Minecraft's historical eras with their own terrain, textures, sounds and rules: 1.6.4, Beta 1.7.3, Alpha 1.2.6, Infdev, Classic 0.30 and the first Cave game build, with the old Nether of 1.6.4, Beta and Alpha. Old textures and sounds are read from your own copies of those versions.
